2608.29175.title: An Explainable Coherence Score for Detecting Temporal Inconsistencies in Political News
2608.29175.paper_summary: Temporal inconsistencies, such as mandates attributed outside their real interval, events presented as past before they occurred, or inverted causal sequences, are a form of political disinformation that evades style-based fake news detectors: a well-written article with a single wrong date carries no lexical signal of falsehood. This paper introduces the Temporal Coherence Score (TCS), a continuous, intrinsically interpretable metric that quantifies the temporal coherence of a news article, computed by a four-stage pipeline: extraction of temporal facts, construction of a temporal knowledge graph, hierarchical verification against internal consistency rules and external reference sources, and score aggregation with automatically generated explanations. Verification combines eight internal checkers derived from Allen's interval algebra with a five-level external hierarchy ranging from a locally stored reference knowledge base of 1{,}256 curated political facts to live Wikidata SPARQL queries. On a benchmark of 100 political news articles with injected temporal errors, the system reaches a precision of 0.909 at the selected operating threshold, with a single residual false positive, a profile deliberately tuned for human-in-the-loop fact-checking assistance, where false alarms are costlier than missed detections. Unlike lexical baselines that output only a binary label, every flagged article is accompanied by the inconsistency type, the entities involved, and the reference source that contradicts the claim.
2608.29175.paper_summary_zh: 時間不一致性，例如在其實際時間範圍之外歸因的命令、在事件發生之前被呈現為過去的事件，或因果序列的顛倒，是一種政治虛假信息，能夠逃避基於風格的假新聞檢測器：一篇寫得很好的文章即使有一個錯誤的日期，也不會傳遞出虛假的詞彙信號。本文介紹了時間一致性評分（Temporal Coherence Score, TCS），這是一種連續的、內在可解釋的指標，用於量化新聞文章的時間一致性，通過四個階段的流程計算得出：提取時間事實、構建時間知識圖譜、根據內部一致性規則和外部參考來源進行分層驗證，以及自動生成解釋的分數聚合。驗證結合了八個源自艾倫（Allen）區間代數的內部檢查器，以及一個五級的外部層級，範圍從本地存儲的1,256個策劃的政治事實的參考知識庫到實時的Wikidata SPARQL查詢。在對100篇注入時間錯誤的政治新聞文章進行基準測試時，該系統在選定的操作閾值下達到了0.909的精度，僅有一個殘餘的假陽性，這是一個故意調整為人機協作事實檢查輔助的配置，其中假警報的成本高於漏檢的成本。與僅輸出二元標籤的詞彙基準不同，每篇被標記的文章都附有不一致類型、涉及的實體，以及與該主張相矛盾的參考來源。
